**Learning Path**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU5253 | SQL for Data Science | Coursera | Foundational SQL skills are essential for data engineering. This course provides a beginner-level introduction to SQL and data analysis. |
| 2 | COU4808 | Learn SQL Basics for Data Science Specialization | Coursera | Building on the foundational SQL skills, this course provides a comprehensive introduction to SQL and data science concepts. |
| 3 | COU5092 | Introduction to Data Engineering | Coursera | This course provides a beginner-level introduction to data engineering concepts, including database management and data processing. |
| 4 | COU1795 | Data Engineering Foundations Specialization | Coursera | This course provides a comprehensive introduction to data engineering concepts, including ETL, data warehousing, and data visualization. |
| 5 | COU3684 | DeepLearning.AI Data Engineering Professional Certificate | Coursera | This course provides an intermediate-level introduction to advanced data engineering concepts, including data management, dataops, and data modeling. |

**How the path fits together**

This learning path is designed to gradually increase in cognitive load, starting with foundational SQL skills and progressing to advanced data engineering concepts. The first two courses provide a comprehensive introduction to SQL and data science, while the third course introduces data engineering concepts. The fourth course provides a comprehensive introduction to data engineering, and the fifth course provides an intermediate-level introduction to advanced data engineering concepts.
